description: Sous-stations de chauffage urbain dans des bâtiments de Rennes, Ville et Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction du Patrimoine Bâti. Cette couche indique la localisation et les caractéristiques des sous-stations de chauffage urbain (Réseaux Sud et Nord-Est) alimentant des bâtiments de la Ville de Rennes et de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are réseau de chauffage urbain. The portal shows 115 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
